mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.mkid, t.xmid, t.mksm, j.xmzwmc, j.xmdw, j.pym FROM bgxt_tsbbsz t JOIN sys_jyxm j ON t.xmid = j.xmid WHERE t.mkid = #{mkid} ORDER BY j.xmzwmc
